neha: Quick sync — planned coordinated rollout next Tue 2026-08-03 01:00 UTC. Aim: API + runtime + router. Console held. Need quick agreement on pins and rollback triggers.

ryan: I'm okay with that. Current pins: runtime=1.4.0, router=1.3.2, api=2026-07. Console has a client header rename so hold makes sense.

lee: Router 1.3.3 exists with header-compat but no prod smoke. Propose router stay at 1.3.2 for T0, then 1.3.3 to 1% canary at T+1h.

neha: Sounds good. Deploy flags?

deploy-bot: Scheduled wave 9011 for 2026-08-03T01:00:00Z. Flags: --stagger=6m --steps=10,20,30,40 --pin=runtime:1.4.0,router:1.3.2 --health-gate=true. Preflight at T-25.

ryan: Rollback triggers I'd like: auto-rollback if 5xx > 0.7% for two consecutive steps OR p95 > 2x baseline for two steps. Add KV-hit drop >6% sustained as a pause.

lee: Add streaming error guard: partial/resume failures >0.25% should pause. Also page eng-sre on any auto-pause.

sre-oncall: I'll take pager. Preflight script: `./preflight.sh --targets api,runtime,router --shadow 1% --expect-p95<350ms --kv-hit>92` at T-25. If preflight fails we HOLD.

neha: One more: allow fast-unpin override in emergencies. deploy-bot, whats the form?

deploy-bot: Fast-unpin: `/deploy fast-unpin --wave 9011 --component runtime --to 1.3.8` requires 2 approvers from eng-releases or 1 eng-sre + 1 eng-platform.

ryan: Also request we increase telemetry retention for the canary shard to 2h.

sre-oncall: Done. Canary retention bumped.

deploy-bot: Preflight complete @1782010200. Staging smoke: api OK, runtime KV-hit 94.1%, router sanity OK. Shadow run shows p95 within baseline.

neha: Good. Locking plan: T0 deploy API+runtime+router pinned as above; console deferred. Auto-rollback/pause criteria noted. I'll post a short release note and pin this thread.

lee: I'll schedule router 1.3.3 canary at T+1h and post results.

ryan: All set from infra side.

sre-oncall: Oncall ready. Will post step updates and escalate if needed.

neha: Thanks — proceeding unless objections. :lock:
